notes: Evidence is UNOFFICIAL election-night results; no official 2026 primary report was found on the county's official canvass page. The 2026 Republican ballot printed one contest per precinct titled 'REP COMMITTEE CHAIRPERSON <precinct>', vote for 1; this is taken to be the precinct committee seat (the 2022 official results show 'Republican Committee Person <precinct>' contests for the same 10 precincts, but with vote for 2 in five precincts and vote for 1 in five), so the seat count and label are not fully verified. No printed candidate appeared in any precinct. Seats are 'empty' where zero write-in votes were reported and 'unknown' where write-in votes were cast, since the report does not show whether a write-in winner qualified or accepted. Late-counted ballots could change the write-in figures. Appointments after the primary are not reflected.
